purpose: The service copies a defined set of production tables every night into a staging bucket from which the analytics vendor downloads them.

components.name: sync-job
components.evidence: sync-job, a scheduled job that runs every night at three o'clock;

components.name: analytics read replica
components.evidence: the analytics read replica (PostgreSQL), a read-only copy of the production database from which the job reads;

components.name: staging bucket
components.evidence: the staging bucket (S3), where the job writes extract files and from which the analytics vendor downloads them;

components.name: Analytics vendor
components.evidence: the Analytics vendor, the external company that loads the files into its own warehouse.

flows.evidence: the job reads the configured tables from the replica,
the job writes one extract file per table under a temporary name into the bucket and renames it when it is complete.
